implementation: Select up to24/32 relevant-floor candidates by scanning at most the admitted512-point domain, stopping when the existing allowance fills. Retain original order within the floor.

Apply to visited destination-floor access, current-floor visited/transit sources, destination landing nodes and supported target-floor transit. Native nodes remain candidates, not proof of accessible routes or visited rooms.

Original support probes, floor bands, eight cached connector/access buckets, per-room recovery, current movement authority and physical coverage checks remain. No model-specific route, synthetic point, new worker/timer or completion credit. Partner-entry recovery remains unchanged.
cost: Up to512 coordinate/floor checks per helper call rather than a24/32 model prefix. At most five such selections in one changed-room approach construction; each stops when its allowance fills. Candidate ranking and geometry-probe ceilings remain24/32. Sparse-floor CPU cost rises and is not measured.
limits: Same-floor samples still have finite24/32 allowances; this is not exhaustive pathfinding or proof all model points are reachable.
